english.title: Service provider hold self out as approved in terms not approved - Private Security Industry Act 2001
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being registered as an approved provider under section 14 of the Private Security Industry Act 2001 of security industry services, held yourself out as registered in terms that had not been approved by the Private Security Industry Authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(2)(b) and (3) of the Private Security Industry Act 2001.
